failure.summary: The card ID resolver body was displaced during the universal feature patch, and the universal schema did not use visible candidate-card/target resolution.
failure.impact: The dataset had the correct tensor shapes but lost nearly all observation and target card identities.
failure.audit_note: The original audit passed because it checked shapes, splits, sources, and legal labels but did not assert semantic token population.

changes: Restore card ID parsing before dataset generation
Use visible candidate-card and target resolution for the universal schema
Add unit assertions for non-padding state, entity, action, and deck-count features
Rebuild and re-audit the frozen 0001 corpus before restarting training
